name: AI Chatbot Widget
author: Aparajeeta

sections.description:
This plugin automatically injects an AI-powered chatbot widget into your WordPress site’s header. The chatbot appears as a floating widget that visitors can interact with for customer service, lead generation, and automated conversations.

Key Features:
* Automatic Integration – No manual code editing required
* Configurable Position – Choose from bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, or top-left
* Easy Setup – Just enter your chatbot token and activate
* Responsive Design – Works seamlessly on all devices
* Zero Coding Required – Simple admin interface for configuration

Benefits:
1. Automate Customer Service with AI-powered responses
2. Capture leads and visitor information automatically
3. Provide 24/7 support without human intervention
4. Improve user engagement and conversion rates

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses the AI Chatbot service from gentai.instamart.ai to display the chatbot widget. The plugin automatically loads the chatbot script from their servers. For more information, including their terms of use and privacy policy, please visit gentai.instamart.ai.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ai-chatbot-widget/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings -> AI Chatbot in your WordPress admin panel.
  4. Enter your chatbot token from gentai.instamart.ai.
  5. Configure the position and other settings as desired.
  6. The chatbot widget will automatically appear on your site!
sections.faq:
How do I get a chatbot token?

You can register and get a chatbot token from gentai.instamart.ai.

Where does the chatbot appear on my site?

The chatbot appears as a floating widget on every page of your site. You can choose the position (bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, or top-left) from the plugin settings.

Can I disable the chatbot temporarily?

Yes! You can enable or disable the chatbot anytime from the plugin settings without deactivating the entire plugin.

Does the chatbot work on mobile devices?

Yes, the chatbot widget is fully responsive and works seamlessly on all devices including smartphones and tablets.

Will this slow down my website?

No, the chatbot widget is loaded asynchronously and will not affect your website’s loading speed.
